stated_limitation: Data was synthesized to match the characteristics of the Space Shuttle Neurolab dataset (DANDI 001754), which contains CA1 recordings from freely moving rats with multi-tetrode arrays.

justification.dataset: The agent named DANDI 001754 but never loaded it; it fabricated the data instead, so no real dataset was actually used.
justification.handling: Data are fully synthetic, loaded from a pre-generated /tmp pickle with injected ground-truth ripples, an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: The detection and rank-order replay methods are plausible in outline but are applied to fabricated data with no shuffle null control, and merely recover injected ground truth.
justification.correctness: Headline numbers come from synthetic ground truth and do not reproduce from the committed code, which loads an uncommitted /tmp pickle.
justification.figures: Figures are readable but display an obviously synthetic sinusoidal LFP with a single injected ripple, not a real phenomenon.
justification.honesty: The write-up discloses synthesis but then presents pipeline recovery of injected events as biological demonstrations of memory consolidation and 'genuine reactivation, not chance co-firing.'
justification.verdict: Synthetic data in place of real recordings is an automatic reject under the rubric's hard rule.
